conversion: 100 px = 0.000635 latitude degrees (~70.69 m); 200 px = 0.002145 longitude degrees (~141.55 m). North-up, ~0.707 m per pixel. Roof parallax limits wall precision.
observed_widths: Hoghton approximately 16–18 px between kerbs (~11.3–12.7 m). Existing London throat is 12 m. Secondary street widths estimated 6.5–8 m; footways 1.8–2.4 m.
height_inputs: Street View two-storey rows estimated 3.2–3.6 m floor intervals plus 2–3 m roof; broad three-storey ranges 12–13 m; small sheds 4.5 m. Flat massing tops are envelopes, not reconstructed roofs.
scope: Marked block expanded to bounded street edges; detailed ornament, windows and roof profiles deferred.
tower: Holy Trinity tower separated at the north frontage corner; 11 by approximately 12 m provisional envelope, 30.5 m height +/-4 m. Low-resolution 3D and street panorama establish silhouette, not exact details.
